messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — Nimbus hardware just updated lead times for the reserved A100/T4 blades. They moved to 8–12 weeks from the 4 weeks we expected. This affects Dedicated capacity for APAC pilots. :grimacing:
Priya Patel: Oof. Which reservation is this? We promised two enterprise pilots a Dec start date.
Alex Kim: It's PO 2025-REDW-789 (reservation RES-3342). Partner Ops sent the timeline this morning. They say partial splits are possible but need final allocation by EOD Friday or they'll reassign stock.
Tom Rivers: Can we backfill from hosted for APAC temporarily? What are the networking/SLA implications for routing hosted -> dedicated?
Ben O'Neill: We have ~30% spare on hosted in us-west but nothing in ap-southeast. Routing hosted traffic through region will add latency and we need to flag SLA impact to the customers.
Maria Gonzales: Also: marketplace listing for the SI bundle is scheduled the week after the pilot launch — if hardware slips, marketing wants to delay the joint announcement. Need a decision fast. :calendar:
Priya Patel: If partner will split shipment, can we prioritize APAC pilot units first and push eu-west later? That helps the marketplace timing.
Alex Kim: Partner quoted this split option but requires confirmation of SKU counts per region. They gave an example allocation table.
Alex Kim: ```
RES-3342 allocation request:
- APAC (ap-southeast): 8 x A100
- EU (eu-west): 6 x A100
- US (us-west): 10 x T4
```
Priya Patel: I can commit APAC 8 A100s if we move 4 T4 from hosted to dedicated as temporary mix. Anyone object?
Ben O'Neill: Works from infra side but we need to open a change with SRE for routing and update the cost model — hosted token unit economics differ.
Tom Rivers: Also ping legal — partner terms mention penalty if we push dates after the allocation window. Could be a cost we haven't modeled.
Maria Gonzales: I'll loop in marketing about the announcement contingency. If we secure APAC units, we'll keep the joint PR but add a note about phased availability.
PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: allocation confirmation deadline for RES-3342 is 2025-11-21 17:00 UTC. No confirmation by deadline may trigger automatic reallocation per partner SLA.
Alex Kim: Action items: 1) Priya to confirm APAC 8 A100 by EOD Thu. 2) Ben to propose hosted->dedicated routing plan and cost delta by tomorrow. 3) Maria to draft marketplace announcement contingency. 4) Tom to check legal on penalty exposure. I'll coordinate with Nimbus for nightly updates.
Priya Patel: On it. I'll confirm APAC numbers after quick inventory sync with sales (30m).
Ben O'Neill: Starting routing impact assessment now.
Tom Rivers: Reaching out to legal now.
Maria Gonzales: Drafting contingency copy, will share in #marketing in 2 hrs.
Alex Kim: Thanks all. If partner sends revised ETA or price delta, I'll post here. :thumbsup:
